learning_outcomes.text: Students get familiar with MS Office package.
Students are prepared for programming with Visual Basic for Application.
Students become able to efficiently use the applications in Office environment.
Students become able to develop their own applications.

assessment_methods.method: Continuous assessment (two tests, entry test, workshop participation)

assessment_rules: Continuous assessment is carried out for controlling students’ progress and forming their final grades. Students perform two tests during the semester and complete a course assignment. Semester validation is obtained after student’s regular attendance at lectures, active participation in workshop sessions, minimum 70 scores, and a successfully presented course assignment. The continuous assessment is formed as an average of the grades from the two tests, considering the grade from the entry test and workshop performance.
